Commentary.Commentary: Windies trail by 78 runs at the end of it. It could have been much worse, had it not been for Hetmyer's counter-attack first and then a late fightback from Dowrich. Both stroked attacking fifties and their 92-run stand really pulled things back for the tourists. Naeem Hasan shone with the ball as he took his maiden Test 5-fer on debut, leading the charge for the hosts. Bangladesh have their noses ahead for sure, and they would like to pile on this healthy lead that they have. But, if the Windies could pluck a few wickets before end of day's play, things just could get really interesting. Join us back in a short while for Bangladesh's 2nd innings.

OUT! Edged and gone! Shakib wraps things up. Floats it around off on a driving length, it spins away and takes the outside edge of Gabriel's hanging bat. It deflects off Rahim's pads and goes into Mahmudullah's hands. WINDIES ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 246!
Stays back and keeps it out safely.
SIX! What a way to get off the mark! Tossed up around off, Gabriel goes down and nails the slog sweep. Middles it well and clears mid-wicket for a maximum.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Dowrich works it off his pads and gets a single for it.
Short, flat and around off, the batsman goes back and keeps it out.
Shakib Al Hasan returns.
Shakib Al Hasan returns.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up on middle, Gabriel defends off the back foot.
Floated on middle, Dowrich flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted delivery again on middle, the batsman defends off the back foot.
SIX! What a shot. Flighted delivery on middle, Dowrich plays a slog sweep and lofts over mid-wicket for a biggie.
FOUR! Good shot. Tossed up outside off, Dowrich plays a reverse sweep towards point for a beautiful boundary.
Gabriel survives. Defends this flat ball with a straight bat.
Hit to sweeper cover and a single is taken.
Fuller on the stumps, the ball takes an inside edge back onto his boots.
Fifty for Shane Dowrich, 8th in Test cricket. Solid knock from him. He gets to the milestone by lifting this over wide mid off and coming back for the second.
Short and wide outside off, Dowrich slaps the punch to sweeper cover. Doesn't take the run though.
Full and attacking the stumps, played back to the bowler.

Spinning in on middle and leg, Gabriel goes behind to play at it but it catches him high on the thigh pad.
Full and darted on off, blocked with the full face.
Turning in on middle, Gabriel looks to defend but it goes off his pads into short leg's hands.
Shannon Gabriel is the last man in for Windies.

OUT! Right through the gate! A 5-fer on Test debut for Naeem Hasan. He loops it up nicely around off, Warrican plays away from his body and it spins in sharply. Goes in the big gap between bat and pad and disturbs the furniture behind.
Tossed up outside off, Dowrich drives through the line and finds long off for a single.
Loopy delivery on off, Warrican defends off the front foot.
Floated on off, Dowrich gets an edge towards slips. They get a single.
Flighted delivery again on off, Dowrich plays it to covers.
Floated on middle, the batsman defends off the back foot.
Flighted delivery on off, Dowrich blocks it well.
Turn and bounce on this one, Dowrich tries to defend but it rises very high on him and is beaten.
Flighted delivery on leg, the batsman tries to flick but it goes to the keeper.
Tossed up again on off, Warrican rocks back and cuts it to point. Two runs taken.
Bowls down the leg side, the batsman lets it go.
Loopy delivery on middle, the batsman plays it straight towards the bowler.
Flighted delivery on middle, Warrican defends off the back foot.
Tossed up on middle, Warrican blocks it well.

A lot of air on this one, around off, draws Dowrich forward to block and he gets beaten due to the turn away from him. Some extra bounce too, which takes Rahim by surprise. He collects it well though.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Goes with the spin and punches it through the line on the off side.
Landed short around off, it spins away slightly, Dowrich is on the back foot to keep this one out.
Leans into this full ball and eases it to the cover fielder.
Looped up delivery on the stumps, Shane with a solid front foot block.
Floated on off, the batsman defends off the front foot.
Loopy delivery on middle, the batsman flicks it to the leg side.
Flighted delivery on middle, Warrican defends off the back foot.
LEG BYES! Tossed up again on leg stump, the batsman gets it off his pads and it runs to the fine leg region. Two runs taken.
Flighted delivery on middle, Warrican defends off the back foot.
Tossed up on middle, Warrican defends off the front foot.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Tossed up in line of the stumps, flicked away through mid-wicket for a run.
Stays on the back foot and guards it out to safety.
Short and wide outside off, Jomel is on the back foot in a jiffy as he cuts it square through point for three runs.
This full ball is stroked to mid off.

Dropped! Tough chance though. Fuller on middle and leg, Warrican comes half forward to defend. It takes the inside edge and flies straight to Haque at short leg. He can't react to it quick enough and it bursts through his fingers.
Bowls way down the leg side, Dowrich looks to flick but decides against it.
Flighted delivery on off, Warrican cuts it to covers for a single.
Loopy delivery on middle, Dowrich flicks it to mid-wicket. The batsmen take a run.
Tossed up again on middle, Warrican flicks it to the leg side for one.
Flighted delivery on off, Warrican cuts it to point. Two runs taken.
Tossed up on middle, Dowrich comes forward and plays it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Going across, Warrican waits for it, opens the face and runs it down towards third man for a brace.
Turning in once more, catches the thigh pad of the batsman who misses the flick shot.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

That could have been a catch. Falls safely though. Mehidy bowls it on leg and there's some extra bounce, Warrican goes back to flick but it brushes his glove, goes off his thigh pad and falls right between short leg and leg gully.
Spinning in from around the wicket, on middle and leg, worked down in front of short leg.
Fullish in length and outside off, driven to long off for a single.
Jomel Warrican walks out to the middle.

OUT! He is out of here! Naeem with his 4th of the innings. It's landed outside off and it turns in a long way. Roach moves across his stick to get behind the line and block but is struck on the pads right in the front of the stumps. The appeal and the finger both go up. Roach reviews, thinking it might go down leg, but that isn't the case. Hitting the stumps clearly. Windies lose the review.
Kemar Roach takes the DRS, for an lbw decision against him. He seems to be gone.
It's hit down to long off for a couple of runs.

FOUR BYES! The 200 comes up for the Windies with that. Shorter and spinning in from outside off, Roach looks to cut but instead he's cut in half as the ball goes past the inside edge and through the left of the keeper. It races away to the boundary line.
Kemar Roach is the next batsman in.

OUT! Bishoo is a dead duck. Clearly out. Doesn't take the review either, which is a good call. Naeem bowls a flatter ball on middle, it goes straight one. Bishoo gets low to sweep and misses. Always dangerous when you're playing across the line like that. He's caught around the thigh pad and the appeal goes up. No trouble for the umpire to raise his finger.
Extremely full ball on the stumps, swept through backward square leg. Fine leg moves to his left and cuts it off with his foot. Two runs taken.
Comes from around the wicket and floats it up around off, Bishoo loosely tries to play at it but gets beaten.
Naeem Hasan is called back on.
Tossed up on leg, the batsman flicks it to mid-wicket.
SIX! Beautiful shot. Floated on middle, Dowrich dances down the track and lofts it straight over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Flighted delivery on off, Dowrich tries to defend but gets an inside edge past short leg.
Loopy delivery on middle, Dowrich blocks it well.
Flighted delivery on middle, Bishoo sweeps it to the leg side for a single.
Full on leg, Bishoo blocks it well.
Mehidy Hasan to bowl from the other end.
Flighted delivery again on off, the batsman drives it towards mid off.
Tossed up on off, Dowrich defends off the front foot.
Flighted delivery again on leg, Bishoo sweeps it to the leg side for a single.
Flighted on off, Dowrich rocks back and cuts it to point for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Bishoo sweeps it towards square leg. The batsmen take a run.
Quicker outside off, Bishoo looks to cut but misses it completely and gets beaten on this one.
We are back for the final session of the day. Shane Dowrich and Devendra Bishoo walk out to the middle, with the latter taking strike. Taijul Islam has the ball in his hand. Let's go...
... Day 2, Session 3 ...

An eventful session comes to a close. 133 runs were scored in the session, but three valuable wickets fell. Ambris and Chase were sent back early by Naeem Hasan, but then Shimron Hetmyer came to the middle and he went mental. Where other batsmen were struggling, he was pummeling the ball like it was just another day in the nets. He powered his way to a fine 63, but soon departed to Mehidy Hasan after making a 92-run stand with Dowrich. Windies still trail by 137 runs. Bangladesh are into the tail now, so a lot rides on Shane Dowrich. Will be interesting to see how he does.
Turning into the batsman, on the stumps, Dowrich from the back foot flicks it on the leg side. That's TEA ON DAY 2!
Fuller in length, drilled through towards long off for a double.
Full in length, defended out with the full face.
Uses his feet to get close to the pitch and blocks.

A mix-up in the middle, no harm done in the end. Dowrich goes back and works it to square leg. After a couple of Yes-Nos, Bishoo is sent back after coming halfway down the track. The throw comes in to the keeper but by then Shane makes it inside the crease.
That was in the air. Close one. Spinning in from around the wicket on middle and leg, Dowrich presses forward and it comes off the inner half. Flies just past short leg.
On the fuller side outside off, Shane leans into it and drives it a bit wide of point. He'll get a single for it.
Shane Dowrich has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Some extra bounce for Taijul Islam. He lands this outside off and the ball drips and turns with some extra bounce. Dowrich initially wants to play at it but withdraws at the last second.
Stays inside the crease and guards this out safely.
Too straight in line, Bishoo picks it off his hips and tucks it behind square leg for one.
Darted quick and full on off stump, defended with the full face of the bat.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Places this wide of the fielder and gets a single on this occasion.
Pushes this to mid off for no run.
Quicker delivery on off, defended down with a straight blade in response.
Shortish on middle and leg, a whip-pull is played to find deep backward square leg for a single.
Pushed quicker through the air around off, Dowrich stays back and keeps it out.
Full on middle and leg, swept straight to the man at square leg.
Spinning away from around off, it pops off Dowrich's pads and falls well beside silly point. Probably some inside edge there too.
Looped up and outside off, it's driven square towards point for a run.
Goes fuller this time, it's kept out safely.
Quite short again, outside off, steered to point with an angled bat.

Short and flat around off, spinning away, punched off the back foot and the ball hits the silly point fielder on the ankle. He seems to be in pain and is down on the ground. The physio is out to have a look at him.

OUT! GONE! Wonderful delivery from Mehidy Hasan. The change of bowling does the trick. Full and loopy around off, Hetmyer is drawn forward to defend and the ball turns away late. It takes the edge and this time Rahim takes a sharp catch to his left. A terrific knock from Hetmyer comes to an end.
Short, wide and turning away with some extra bounce, the southpaw backs away and cuts it past short third man. A brace results.
Worked away comfortably through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Now Dowrich joins in on the action. Tossed up on middle and leg, the right-hander gives the charge and bangs it over long on for a biggie.
Spinning in on middle and leg, Shane moves inside the line and works it down towards short fine leg.
Full on the stumps, played back to the bowler.
Short on middle, Hetmyer pulls it to mid-wicket.
Loopy delivery on off, the batsman plays it to covers for a single.
Tossed up again on off, Dowrich defends off the front foot.
Tossed up on off, Dowrich gets an outside edge and it goes towards the slip region.
Flighted on off, Dowrich blocks it well.
Tossed up on middle, Dowrich flicks it towards short mid-wicket.
SIX! There's no stopping this kid, is there? Doesn't hold anything back at all. Landed short, so Hetmyer goes back and muscles it over long on for half a dozen.
FOUR! That was close. Just about clears mid off. Full and outside off, Hetmyer just about manages to clear the diving fielder there for a boundary.

Fifty for Shimron Hetmyer! His 3rd in this format. Short and on the stumps, he rocks back and pulls it powerfully to deep mid-wicket for two runs. He's got there in quick time, great counter-attack from the youngster.
Strays on the pads, worked away in front of square leg for a single.
Looped up on the stumps, driven back in the bowler's direction.
Short and spinning down, goes off Hetmyer's gloves and the batsmen take a single.

FIVE RUNS! Tossed up on off, Dowrich tries to defend but misses it completely and it goes behind the keeper and hits the helmet. Umpire signals it five runs after checking it if it had hit the helmet.
A referral is taken. The umpire wants to check whether the ball hit the helmet behind Mushfiqur Rahim.
Loopy delivery on leg stump, Dowrich flicks it to the leg side.
Flighted delivery on off, Hetmyer rocks back and cuts it to covers for a single.
Tossed up on off, the batsman plays it to covers for a single.
Flighted delivery on off, Dowrich blocks it well.
FOUR! Tossed on middle, Dowrich sweeps it towards square leg for a beautiful boundary.
Mahmudullah to roll his arm over now.
Tossed up on off, Dowrich cuts it towards point for a single.
Loopy delivery on off, the batsman defends off the front foot.
Flighted delivery again on off, Dowrich plays it to cover.
Short on middle, Hetmyer pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted delivery on off, Dowrich rocks back and cuts it towards covers for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Dowrich blocks it well.
Shakib Al Hasan is back on.
Eases this away to the long on fielder and keeps strike.
Quicker one on off, pushed by getting behind the line to short mid-wicket.
Too straight in line, easy enough for Dowrich to nudge it fine down the leg side for a couple of runs.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Spinning away from a shorter length outside off, Shimron backs away and cuts it square past point for one.
Full in length on the stumps, driven through mid on for a single.
Fuller outside off, defended from the outer half on the off side. 11 from the over.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Shimron Hetmyer. The stones on this boy. The ball is turning and he still plays through the line and lofts it cleanly over wide long off for a maximum.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Hetmyer rocks back and cuts it fiercely through point for a boundary.
Extremely full outside off, drilled through the covers for a single.
Full and straight from Naeem, Dowrich drives it straight back. The spinner dives to his left and makes a good stop.
Steps out of the crease and defends it tightly.
Floated again on middle, Hetmyer again blocks it well.
Floated on off, Hetmyer blocks it well.
Tossed up again on middle, the batsman defends off the back foot.
Loopy delivery on off, the batsman plays it to point.
FOUR! Good shot. Flighted delivery on leg, Hetmyer lofts it over mid on for a beautiful boundary.
Tossed up on middle, Hetmyer defends off the front foot.
Flighted full and well outside off, it's tamely pushed to covers.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Short and wide outside off, cut away square straight to point.
Spinning away from outside off, played to point for no run.
Flicked away with the wrists into the leg side for one run.
Leans into the full ball and drives it through to long off for a single.
Floated on middle, Dowrich flicks it to the leg side. Two runs taken.
Flighted delivery again on middle, the batsman pushes it to the leg side.
Loopy delivery on off, the batsman drives it straight back towards the bowler.
Flighted delivery on off, Dowrich drives it towards mid off.
Tossed up on off, the batsman plays it to covers. Single collected.
BEATEN! Drifts away from the batsman, Hetmyer goes for the slog but misses it completely.
Mehidy Hasan comes back into the attack.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Goes deep inside the crease and works it off the pads.
Neat timing. Dowrich caresses it through the covers for a couple of runs.
Spinning down leg, Shane attempts to tickle it fine but fails to do so.
Stays on the back foot and cracks the punch through covers for a single.
Spinning away from around the off stump, Hetmyer comes forward to play at it but is caught on the pads. Appeal for an lbw goes up, but it's always missing off.
Drinks are on the field.
Tossed up outside off, the batsman lets it go.
Loopy delivery on off, Dowrich plays it towards covers.
Tossed up again on middle, the batsman flicks it towards mid on for a single.

SIX! Consecutive sixes for Hetmyer. Tossed up again on leg stump, Hetmyer again goes for the slog sweep and lofts it over square leg for a biggie. This is the way Hetmyer plays. Aggressive style of cricket.
SIX! Good shot. Flighted delivery on middle, Hetmyer lofts it over mid-wicket for a biggie. This is the first six of the innings.
Bowls quicker on middle stump, Hetmyer defends off the back foot.
A mistimed shot from Dowrich. He swipes across the line and somehow manages to clear mid on. A couple of runs taken to end the over.
This full delivery is driven down to long off for a single.
Fuller around off, going away, it takes the outer half of the bat and falls on the off side.
FOUR! A bit on the shorter side, Hetmyer goes back and lofts it over mid on for a boundary.
A bit quicker through the air, around off, spins away and beats the outside edge of Hetmyer's bat.

Flighted delivery on leg stump, the batsman flicks it to the leg side.
HUGE APPEAL FOR LBW! Flighted delivery on middle, Dowrich tries to defend but gets hit on the pads. The bowler appeals but the umpire shakes his head.
Tossed up on off, the batsman plays it to covers.
Flighted delivery on off, Dowrich drives to covers.
Tossed up outside off, Dowrich tries to defend but misses it and gets beaten.
Tossed up on middle, Hetmyer goes for the slog sweep over mid-wicket but does not get the distance and fell short of the deep mid-wicket fielder. The batsmen pick up a single.
Full and wide outside off, driven through the covers for a double. Dowrich is off the mark.
Shane Dowrich to bat next.

OUT! Naeem Hasan with his second wicket in Test cricket. Both the set batsmen are now back in the dressing room. He continues from around the wicket and lands it around off, it spins in and raps Ambris on the pads as he goes back to play at it. A big shout goes up and so does the finger. Sunil reviews it and replays show that impact is umpire's call and it's clipping the off stump as well, so that belongs to the umpire too. The review isn't lost, but Sunil departs.
Review time. For an lbw decision against Sunil Ambris. Is he gone? Let's see.
Spinning in on middle and leg, Ambris looks to flick but wears it on the pads.
Leans into this full ball and knocks it to the mid on fielder.
Outside off, cut square to point for a run.
Edged but safe! Spinning away from around off, Hetmyer is drawn forward to defend. The ball takes the outside edge but since he played it with soft hands, it fell short of first slip.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and wide outside off, Ambris drives it a bit square through cover-point and manages to come back for the second.
Spinning into the left-hander, Hetmyer turns it away through mid-wicket for a single.
Goes with the turn and works it away on the leg side.
Turning sharply down the leg side, Hetmyer lets it be and the keeper is unable to collect as well. The batsmen collect two byes.
Flat and short outside off, played square towards point for one.
flatter and shorter around off, kept out off the back foot.
Too far outside off, going away, another leave from Shimron.
Spinning away from outside off, left alone for the keeper to collect.
FOUR! Short ball around off, Hetmyer rocks onto the back foot and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Fine way to get off the mark.
Full on middle and off, from around the wicket, Hetmyer prods forward in defense.
Shimron Hetmyer is the new batsman in.

OUT! Soft dismissal. Maiden wicket for Naeem Hasan. Turns into the batsman, Chase comes forward to defend but gets an inside edge towards short leg and is caught by Imrul Kayes. The bowler appeals and the umpire raises his finger immediately. Chase and Ambris made a good partnership between them and it is a huge blow for them with the wicket of Chase. He could not make the most of the life he got.
Looped up on the stumps, blocked safely from the front foot.
Darted around leg, Sunil gets low to sweep but it hits his pads and rolls towards first slip.
Spinning away from around off, Ambris looks defend but is beaten past the outside edge.
Some flight on this outside off, Chase drives it through the covers and gets to the other end.
Landed full and this is driven through covers for another run.
Short and flat outside off, cut behind point for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Not out! That's a very, very good call from umpire Aleem Dar. Naeem bowls it on leg and it spins down as Ambris comes down the track. He misses his flick and Rahim moves to his left, collects the ball and knocks the bails over. During this, however, Sunil turns and plants his bat in. An appeal goes up, Aleem Dar is unmoved, but Bangladesh want it to be referred upstairs. It is taken to the third umpire and replays show that Ambris has made it back just in time. They check for the caught behind too and it shows the batsman is fine.

The umpires are having a chat with each other. Rahim has taken the bails off and there's an appeal for a stumping against Sunil Ambris. Bangladesh are confident they've got their man. Over to the TV umpire now.
Flatter and fuller on middle and off, Ambris skips out to block, but is caught on the pads.

Tossed up on middle, Ambris comes forward and gets it off his pads and it goes towards first slip who comes to his right and takes the catch. The bowler and the fielders appeal but the umpire shakes his head.
Bowls it down the leg side, Ambris lets it go.
Tossed up on off, Ambris came down the track and defends it.
Floated on off, Chase rocks back and cuts it towards short cover.
Flighted delivery on off, Chase defends off the back foot.
Loopy delivery on middle, Ambris flicks it towards the on side for a single.
Tossed up on off, the batsman blocks it well.
Drifts away from the batsman, the batsman again lets it go.
Flighted delivery outside off, Ambris lets it go.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
From around the wicket again, it's darted across, Chase keeps bat and pad close together, gets rapped on the latter.
Roston Chase defends it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Goes deep inside the crease and turns it away into the leg side.
FOUR! Shot. Loopy and full in line of the stumps, Chase gets low and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Pitched just around off and spins from the rough, catches Chase on the pads as he tries to defend.
Naeem Hasan into the attack now for the first time in this innings.
Darted quicker and fuller outside off, stroked straight to the man at short extra cover.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Ambris backs away from this short ball and places it straight to point.
Quicker delivery just outside off, blocked from within the crease.

Not out! Good review from Ambris. Flighted delivery on middle stump, Ambris goes for the sweep but misses it and gets hit on the pads. The bowler appeals and the umpire raises his finger. Windies opt for a review. He gets a glove on that. Decision is overturned and Ambris is safe.
Review taken by Sunil Ambris. He's been adjudged lbw and he's taken the DRS instantly. Some glove on it? Could be. Let's see.
Tossed up on off, Ambris  drives it over the cover fielder. The fielder tried to catch but it went over him. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Closes the face of the bat, works this full ball against the spin through mid-wicket for one run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Looped up on middle and off, Ambris is half forward to defend but the ball takes a safe leading edge back down the track.
Positions himself well behind the line and keeps it out.
Angling in from outside off, Chase backs away and forces the punch to sweeper cover for a single.
Slower through the air, in line of the stumps, Chase is well forward in defense.
Flighted delivery outside off, the batsman again offers no shot.
Tossed up again outside off, the batsman offers no shot.
Loopy delivery on off stump, Ambris plays it towards point.
Flighted delivery on off stump, Chase drives it towards long off for a single.
Tossed up on off, Chase blocks it well.
Spinning away from the batsman, Chase lets it go.
Flighted delivery again on off, the batsman cuts it towards covers for a single.
Floated on middle stump, Chase plays it towards covers.
Loopy delivery on off stump, Ambris drives it towards mid off for a single.
Tossed up again on leg stump, Chase flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, the batsman defended off the front foot.
Tossed up on middle, Chase defends off the front foot.
Quite slow through the air, outside off, Ambris hangs his bat inside the line and gets beaten.
Goes with the spin and strokes this through the gap in the covers. Single collected.
Darted quick and full outside off, drilled to sweeper cover. One more run to the total.
Nicely drifting in on middle and off, Chase drives it through the covers for a run.
Full on the stumps, eased down to long off for a single.
Quicker and flatter around off, Ambris goes back and keeps it out.
Shakib Al Hasan to bowl from the other end.
Tossed up again on off, the batsman drives it towards mid on. The batsmen take a run.
Flighted delivery again on off stump, the batsman defends off the front foot.
Tossed up again on middle stump, the batsman defends off the back foot.
Loopy delivery on off stump, the batsman plays it towards covers.
Flighted delivery on leg stump, Ambris flicks it towards the leg side. The batsmen get two runs.
Tossed up outside off, Ambris looks to go for the slog but misses it completely and gets beaten.

We are back for the second session of the day. Sunil Ambris and Roston Chase stride out to the middle with their team still trailing by 270 runs. Taijul Islam will start proceedings. Two slips and a silly point in place for him.
... Day 2, Session 2 ...

What a riveting session of Test cricket as 5 wickets in total have gone before the Lunch break. Bangladesh are clearly on top here. It started with the Tigers being bowled out rather early for 324, and when Windies came out to bat, the Bangla spinners did the trick once again. Taijul got rid of Powell first, then Shakib bagged two in his very first over dismissing Hope and Brathwaite. He should have had two more and the visitors should have been 5 down by now, as both Ambris and Chase were dropped off the Bangla skipper's bowling. The afternoon session is going to be mighty difficult for the away side. Do tune in for all the action.
Spinning away, Ambris dabs it down towards short third man and takes one. LUNCH ON DAY 2!
Sunil Ambris has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Dropped! Off Shakib's bowling again. Oh, dear! Tossed up on the stump, Chase gets low to play the big slog sweep over mid-wicket. There's a man out in the deep for this very reason. Mustafizur is the man, he runs in and dives, gets his hands to it but can't hold on. Should have been taken, was a relatively easy chance. Single taken.
Full and outside off, eased away to covers.
Watches the ball, stays right behind the line and blocks.
Coming in at first and then turning away from middle, Chase goes deep inside the crease and blocks it out.
Change of ends for Shakib Al Hasan. Probably the last over before Lunch.
Loopy delivery on leg stump, Chase flicks it towards the leg side. The batsmen take a run.
Flighted delivery again on middle, the batsman defends off the back foot.
FOUR! Good shot. Floated on middle, Chase sweeps it towards square leg for a beautiful boundary.
Tossed up again on middle, the batsman flicks it towards square leg. The batsmen take a run.
Flighted delivery outside off,  Ambris blocks it well.
Tossed up on off, Chase hits it towards mid on for a single.
Mehidy Hasan is called back on.
Drives this floated ball wide of mid off and gets to the other end.
Close. Taijul bowls it quicker on the stump, short in length, Chase goes back and gets it off the outer half. His inside edge hit his pads in the process.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman. Dot ball.
Full and straight, driven back in the bowler's direction.
FOUR! Good shot. Remains patient as he waits for the ball to come to him, rocks back and cuts it behind point to find the fence. Well done, Roston Chase.
Pitched outside off and it spins away, Chase lets it go.
Floated on middle, the batsman defends off the back foot.
Flighted delivery on middle, the batsman gets behind and blocks it well.
Loopy delivery on off, the batsman defends off the front foot.
Floated on the line of middle stump, the batsman drives it towards mid off.
Flighted delivery on off, Ambris drives it towards covers.
Tossed up outside off stump, Ambris drives it towards mid off.
Tossed up again on off stump, the batsman defends off the front foot.
Bowls quicker on middle stump, Chase gets an edge towards first slip. It falls well short of the fielder.
Floated on off stump, the batsman drives it towards covers. The batsmen take a run.
Tossed up on leg stump, the batsman flicks it towards the leg side.
Flighted delivery on middle stump, Ambris defends off the back foot.
Gives a bit of air on off stump, Ambris drives it towards covers.
FOUR! A rare poor delivery and it's gotten the punishment it deserves. Half tracker outside off, Chase is on the back foot as he drags the pull aerially through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flat, short and on off, punched off the back foot back to the bowler.
Sprays it too straight, on the pads, turned against the spin in front of square leg for one.
Full and loopy, just around off, driven but straight to mid off.
Flicked away through mid-wicket for a single this time.
Drifting in on middle and leg, Chase flicks it neatly through mid-wicket and takes two.
Nice shape on it as Taijul lands it fuller around off, kept out with the full face by Ambris.
Presses forward once again and buries it into the track.
Full on off, blocked by coming well forward.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Ambris gets a safe leading edge on the off side as he closes the face a bit early.

A half appeal for a caught behind. Is there an edge? Don't think so, neither does the umpire. Spinning away from around off, Ambris hangs his bat to defend but the ball turns and goes off the thigh pad to first slip.
Roston Chase to bat next.

OUT! Second of the over for the man with the golden arm! What an over this has been. He gives this plenty of flight and pitches it on off, Brathwaite is drawn forward to defend but the Windies skipper loses his balance somewhat in the process. The ball bounces a lot more than expected, takes the shoulder of the bat and pops to Soumya Sarkar at first slip who takes a dolly.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Ambris is off the mark with a flick on the leg side. Single to the total.

Dropped! Sharp chance but Rahim should have taken that. Shakib lands it on off and it turns away ever so slightly. Ambris hangs his bat out to dry and gets a feather behind. The keeper react quickly to take it.
Looped up on off, kept out from inside the crease.
Sunil Ambris is the new man in.

OUT! That's the second wicket down in as many overs. BOWLED! Shakib is brought into the attack and he starts with a wicket. Beautiful delivery. Flighted delivery on leg stump, Hope comes down the track and looks to play towards the leg side but completely misses the line and gets bowled. Windies in some trouble as they lose their second wicket.
Shakib Al Hasan brings himself into the attack.
Full on middle and leg, flicked to short mid-wicket to end a successful over from Taijul.
Quicker through the air on middle and off, kept out well off the back foot.
Off the mark with that. Hope goes deep inside the crease and whips the arm ball through mid-wicket for a single.
Beaten! Nicely loops it up around off, Hope comes forward to defend but the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Full and outside off, spinning away, pushed to the covers by Hope for nothing.

OUT! Powell is gone for all money! Dead plumb. Poor review too, shouldn't have taken it in the first place. Windies lose a review as well. It's tossed right up there, on the stumps, Kieran Powell kneels down to sweep and misses the shot completely. Is struck on the front pad and big appeal goes up, which is followed by umpire Aleem Dar's finger. Powell, after having a long chat with his skipper, reviews it. It's taken upstairs and Ball Tracker shows three reds. First wicket for the hosts. Meanwhile, Shai Hope is the next batsman in.
The DRS is taken. It's for an lbw decision against Kieran Powell. He looks to be gone.
Tossed up on middle stump, the batsman flicks it towards the leg side.
Flighted delivery on middle stump, Brathwaite flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Loopy delivery on off stump, the batsman dances down the track and plays it towards mid off for a single.
FOUR! Good shot. Flighted delivery on off stump, Powell rocks back and cuts it through point for a beautiful boundary.
Tossed up again on middle stump, Powell again comes forward and defends off the front foot.
Tossed up on middle stump, Powell comes forward and defends off the front foot.
Drinks break.
Turning as it's floated around off, Brathwaite defends from the front foot.
Full and straight, pushed defensively back down the track.
Backs away to this one and places the punch square to point.
Drifting in on off, buried into the track from the front foot.
FOUR! Takes the aerial route and gets the desired result. It's tossed right up in the slot, Brathwaite lofts it cleanly over mid off for a boundary.
Turning it away from off stump, a play and a miss from Kraigg.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Drives this full ball through mid on for a single.

Extra bounce out of nowhere! Mehidy continues from around the wicket and floats it across, Brathwaite tries to defend but the ball goes through bat and pad. Rahim is taken by surprise as the ball just shoots up and hits him on the chest.
FOUR! Brathwaite too gets his dancing shoes on and slogs it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Steps out of the crease to get close to the pitch and then wrists it away through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! That's a very good shot. Well executed. Sees the flight on the ball as it's landed full, Powell gets low early and then sweeps it away through square leg for a boundary.
Beaten on this occasion! Once again it turns away from the batsman, Brathwaite looks to poke at it but can't.
Sharp turn away, from around off, left alone for the keeper to collect.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Comes from around the wicket and serves it on leg, it turns away. Brathwaite goes inside the crease and blocks it down with gentle hands.
Quicker delivery, it's flicked through to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flat, short and around off, turning in, Powell skips down the track and defends it well.
Keeps it out well by taking a big stride forward and meeting it with the full face.
Flighted delivery on middle and off, the right-hander comes forward to block, but the ball takes the glove and thuds onto the pads.
Keeps a bit low too as it turns in. Brathwaite goes on the back foot and flicks it to backward square leg.
Lands it on middle and off and it's spinning in, Kraigg uses the depth of the crease to go back and flicks it square on the leg side.
Stays right behind the line and blocks.
Uses his feet to get close to the pitch and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Plays with the spin as he opens the bat face and taps it down on the off side.
Full on off, Brathwaite presses forward and defends.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and loopy, on the stumps, driven straight back to the bowler.
Quick, flat and short around off, kept out from the back foot.
From around the wicket, it's tossed up on off, driven to mid off by the batsman.
Taijul Islam to roll his arm over now.
Outside off, turning away, Powell hangs his bat inside the line and gets beaten.

Safe! A good delivery nonetheless. Mehidy loops it up around off and it spins away as Powell plays the expansive drive away from his body. Is beaten and Rahim takes the bails as he sees the batsman drag his back leg out. It's taken upstairs but replays show he's fine.
A stumping appeal is referred upstairs now.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Not out! Good call from Powell. Evident why he was so quick to take the review. Quicker one coming in with the arm on middle and off, Powell goes back to play at it but is rapped on the pads. Big appeal and the umpire responds by raising his finger. Kieran, however, is quick to signal the 'T' and it's taken upstairs. Replays show a big spike on Snicko.
The DRS is taken. Kieran Powell is caught leg before and he's taken it upstairs without any thought. Looks to be plumb here. An inside edge is the only thing that can save him.
Turn instantly. Landed just behind a driving length around off, Powell taps it down on the off side with soft hands.

Comes from around the wicket and it turns in on leg, Brathwaite goes deep inside the crease and flicks it to leg slip. Mahmudullah can't get low enough in time as the ball goes through his legs. Just the single results.
Waits for the ball to come to him before wristing it down in front of mid-wicket.
Darts it on the pads, Kieran Powell works it down on the leg side with soft hands. The pacer came from over the wicket now.
No ball! Second of the over. He's clearly struggling with his run-up. Coming in on a fuller length on middle and leg, Brathwaite clips it behind square leg and crosses over.
Switches to around the wicket now and angles in a length ball on off, blocked from within the crease.
Outside off and moving away, no shot offered by the batsman.
Good length ball quite close to off, Brathwaite stays behind the line and taps it down in front of covers.
No ball! For overstepping. The Fizz angles it across on a good length outside off, Kraigg leaves it alone.
Angles it at first and then straightens up late, Powell looks to defend but the ball goes off the outer half towards covers. A quick single is stolen.
Presses well forward to this tossed up delivery and dead-bats it.
Now Brathwaite is off the mark. Turning in on middle and leg, he moves inside the line and helps the pull fine down the leg side. Gets a couple of runs for doing so.
Quite full on middle and leg, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Spinning down leg again, this time Brathwaite looks to work it away but misses it.
Spinning down leg, Brathwaite lets it be.
First runs for Powell and Windies. It's full and outside off from around the wicket, the left-hander drives it wide of mid off for a single.
Mehidy Hasan to bowl from the other end. Spin straightaway.
Gets right behind the line of this one and meets it with the full face of the bat.
Keeps it close to off once more, Kraigg moves across the stumps and blocks it.
Targets the top of off stump with a length ball, it's played back down the track from within the crease.
Shaping away from around off, on a good length, The Windies skipper lets it be. Good carry for the pacer here.
Full delivery attacking the stumps, Brathwaite flicks it in front of square leg, but the fielder there cuts it off.
Mustafizur starts off with a full toss outside off, Brathwaite plays it straight back to the bowler.
